# Bolys Sabitbek

> Bolys Sabitbek is a mathematician working in the analysis of partial differential equations, currently a postdoctoral researcher at the Ghent Analysis & PDE Center, Ghent University, Belgium. His research covers hyperbolic equations and systems with multiplicities, PDEs with singular and rough coefficients, functional inequalities on stratified Lie groups, and global existence and blow-up of solutions to nonlinear PDEs.

The name is also written Sabitbek Bolys or B. Sabitbek, and in Kazakh Болыс Сәбитбек. Official website: https://sabitbekbolys.github.io/

- Current position: Postdoctoral Researcher, Ghent Analysis & PDE Center, Department of Mathematics: Analysis, Logic and Discrete Mathematics, Ghent University, Belgium.
- Previous position: Postdoctoral Research Assistant, School of Mathematical Sciences, Queen Mary University of London, UK, funded by EPSRC grant EP/V005529/1, working with Claudia Garetto and Michael Ruzhansky.
- Researcher, Department of Differential Equations, Institute of Mathematics and Mathematical Modeling, Almaty, Kazakhstan (since 2010).
- PhD in Mathematics (2019), Al-Farabi Kazakh National University and the Institute of Mathematics and Mathematical Modeling, Almaty; advisors Tynysbek Kalmenov and Michael Ruzhansky.
- MSc in Aerospace Engineering (2016), Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta, USA.
- BSc in Mechanics (2012), Al-Farabi Kazakh National University, Almaty.
- Contact: sabitbek.bolys [at] ugent.be

## Publications

### Journal articles

- [Asymptotics and scattering for critically weakly hyperbolic and singular systems](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.aim.2026.111212): B. Sabitbek, A. Shao. Advances in Mathematics, 503, 111212 (2026). arXiv:2506.11348.
- [Potential wells and thresholds for a strongly damped p-Laplacian wave equation](https://doi.org/10.3934/dcdss.2026106): B. Sabitbek. Discrete and Continuous Dynamical Systems – S (2026).
- [C^∞ well-posedness of higher order hyperbolic pseudo-differential equations with multiplicities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.04927): C. Garetto, B. Sabitbek. Acta Applicandae Mathematicae, 196, 4 (2025).
- [Hardy and Rellich inequalities with Bessel pairs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.07008): M. Ruzhansky, B. Sabitbek. Proceedings of the Edinburgh Mathematical Society (2025).
- [Hyperbolic systems with non-diagonalisable principal part and variable multiplicities, III: singular coefficients](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00208-023-02792-7): C. Garetto, B. Sabitbek. Mathematische Annalen (2024).
- [Global existence and blow-up of solutions to the nonlinear porous medium equation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.06896): B. Sabitbek, B. Torebek. Discrete and Continuous Dynamical Systems (accepted).
- [Blow-up solutions of damped Klein–Gordon equation on the Heisenberg group](https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.02705): M. Ruzhansky, B. Sabitbek. European Journal of Mathematics, 9, 61 (2023).
- [Global existence and nonexistence of solutions for semilinear wave equation with a new condition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.11334): B. Sabitbek. Discrete and Continuous Dynamical Systems (2023).
- [Global existence and blow-up of solutions to porous medium equation and pseudo-parabolic equation, I. Stratified groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.00406): M. Ruzhansky, B. Sabitbek, B. Torebek. Manuscripta Mathematica (2022).
- Blow-up theorems for p-sub-Laplacian heat operators on stratified groups: G. Oralsyn, B. Sabitbek. Complex Analysis and Operator Theory, 16, 99 (2022).
- Geometric Hardy inequalities on starshaped sets: M. Ruzhansky, B. Sabitbek, D. Suragan. Journal of Convex Analysis, 28 (2021).
- Principal frequency of p-versions of sub-Laplacian for general vector fields: M. Ruzhansky, B. Sabitbek, D. Suragan. Zeitschrift für Analysis und ihre Anwendungen, 40, no. 1, 97–109 (2021).
- Geometric Hardy and Hardy–Sobolev inequalities on Heisenberg groups: M. Ruzhansky, B. Sabitbek, D. Suragan. Bulletin of Mathematical Sciences, 10, no. 3, 2050016 (2020).
- Subelliptic geometric Hardy type inequalities on half-spaces and convex domains: M. Ruzhansky, B. Sabitbek, D. Suragan. Annals of Functional Analysis, 11(4), 1042–1061 (2020).
- Hardy and Rellich inequalities for anisotropic p-sub-Laplacians: M. Ruzhansky, B. Sabitbek, D. Suragan. Banach Journal of Mathematical Analysis, 14, 380–398 (2020).
- Weighted anisotropic Hardy and Rellich type inequalities for general vector fields: M. Ruzhansky, B. Sabitbek, D. Suragan. NoDEA Nonlinear Differential Equations and Applications, 26, no. 2, 13 (2019).
- Weighted L^p-Hardy and L^p-Rellich inequalities with boundary terms on stratified Lie groups: M. Ruzhansky, B. Sabitbek, D. Suragan. Revista Matemática Complutense, 32, 19–35 (2019).
- On Green functions for Dirichlet sub-Laplacians on a quaternion Heisenberg group: B. Sabitbek, D. Suragan. Mathematical Modelling of Natural Phenomena, 39 (2018).
- Horizontal weighted Hardy–Rellich type inequality on stratified Lie groups: B. Sabitbek, D. Suragan. Complex Analysis and Operator Theory, 12(6), 1469–1480 (2018).
- Orbit design for a Phobos–Deimos cycler mission: B. Sabitbek, B. Gunter. Advances in the Astronautical Sciences (2018).
- On Hardy and Rellich type inequalities for the Grushin operator: T. Sh. Kalmenov, B. Sabitbek. Mathematical Journal, 18, no. 2(68), 133–142 (2018).
- Hardy and Rellich type inequalities on the complex affine group: B. Sabitbek, D. Suragan. Eurasian Mathematical Journal, 8(2), 31–39 (2017).
- Embedding theorem of Sobolev type spaces on stratified Lie groups: B. Sabitbek. Mathematical Journal, 16, no. 3(61), 166–180 (2016).

### Preprints

- On higher order hyperbolic Cauchy problems with variable multiplicities and (t, x)-dependent coefficients: C. Garetto, B. Sabitbek. Submitted (2025).
